project.title: Metagenomic insights into the sewage RNA virosphere of a large city
project.description: In this study, we used quantitative viral metagenomics to explore the RNA virosphere of wastewater from a treatment plant located in Santiago de Chile, the seventh-largest city in the Americas.
project.center_name: Beatriz Diez lab at Pontificia Universidad Catolica de Chile
